tests.stimulus: First advance to a nonzero time, then assert reset after a falling edge, and check 00:00 and alarm sounding before the next rising edge and during the hold window; after deassertion, check that timekeeping restarts.
tests.expected: After reset is asserted, without waiting for a rising edge of clock, all four display outputs are ASCII 0 (0x30), and alarm_sound is 1. This remains true while reset is held; deassertion does not advance time.
tests.checker: Predict independently only from the inputs and their legal history, and compare the public outputs using four-state inequality in each valid window in expected; record mismatches as UVM_ERROR, require a nonzero actual observation/comparison count for each item, and finish after transactions have drained. Do not generate expectations from actual DUT outputs.

tests.stimulus: After separate resets, hold fastwatch at 0 and 1 respectively, covering the cycle before the first update, the update cycle, the cycle after it, and multiple consecutive periods; predict independently from source-clock cycle counts.
tests.expected: Rising edges after reset deassertion are counted starting from 1; when fastwatch=0, a minute-advance enable is generated every 15360 cycles, time first increments by one minute on cycle 15361, and then increments by one every 15360 cycles. When fastwatch=1, the first increment occurs on cycle 257, followed by one increment every 256 cycles.

tests.stimulus: Starting from reset, traverse the full 1440 minutes using native fast timekeeping, checking every minute and all four types of carry; do not preset the internal time.

tests.stimulus: Maintain the same reset history, switch fastwatch before and after ticks, and independently retain the histories of both enables; cover the first departure from 00:00 and the return to 00:00 after a full day.
tests.expected: fastwatch combinationally selects the existing normal or fast enable; switching does not reset the timing phase. alarm_sound is 1 if and only if the current time is 00:00, including reset and full-day wraparound; it is 0 during all other minutes.
